note: Golden fixtures every implementation MUST reproduce. Only `model_visible` values appear here: a `parsed` digest is collector-local by spec and the two reference implementations legitimately disagree on one. Produced by the Python implementation and verified against the TypeScript one; a future divergence on any identity here is a test failure on both sides rather than a discovery made by comparing two records in production. From version 3, a case may name `request_template`: the part's model_visible digest when it is held, or the reason it is absent; `request_template_serialisation_example` gives the bytes of one serialisation before hashing.
